children: may retest a support at $105.42 per barrel, a break below which could trigger a fall towards the $102.85-$103.83 range.

The contract not only failed to break the resistance at $109.58 again, but also retraced deeply. Its behaviour suggests either a consolidation mode or an uptrend reversal, considering that a five-wave cycle from $86.22 has ended around $109.91.
The pattern from $109.91 looks like a wedge, the nature of which is yet to be confirmed. It will be bullish, if the market breaks $109.58, or bearish, if the support at $105.42 fails to hold.
The preferred scenario is a break below $105.42. On the daily chart, a dark cloud cover formed between September 10 and September 11, complemented by a shooting star on September 14.
This combined candlestick pattern indicates a further drop.
